name: Atomkrieg 1946
summary: Atomkrieg 1946 is a real-time strategy game set in an alternate 1946 where Germany built the atomic bomb first. Two factions fight on land, at sea and in the air: the Atomic Reich with slow, heavy super-tanks, Tesla and isotope weapons and armoured airships, and the Coalition with fast, cheap units in large numbers. Players build a base, mine isotope and refine it into Uranium-235 to arm a nuclear silo while the enemy races to do the same. Features dynamic weather, day and night, naval warfare, a skirmish AI with several difficulty levels and online multiplayer.
